representation.equivalence: same tested tree, owner contract, environment assumptions and test oracle are necessary for evidence reuse

issues.observation: PR #231 earlier owner verification source failed the Runtime sixteen-admission concurrency test (387 passed, 1 failed, 41 ignored). A later PR #231 check passed; this older event is not a live bug claim.

issues.decision: Reuse R04/R01 and native test. Only reopen implementation if the exact candidate reproduces contention.
issues.formalObligation: For admitted concurrent local writers, process-local registry writes must serialize or fail with declared bounded outcomes; do not infer current status from an old CI run.

representation.requiredWitness: Replay exact failing sixteen-admission Runtime test on pinned source/environment and distinguish SQLite lock contention from a stale queue assertion; require owner-native run before promotion.
representation.selectionReason: One historical failing CI run is only an observation. A controlled source-bound reproduction is required to attribute cause; state transitions supply the secondary safety/liveness contract.

issues.observation: PR #218 earlier native Bevy consumer compilation failed because wayland-client.pc was absent from the Linux pkg-config search path. A newer PR head is under qualification; this older failure does not establish present failure.

issues.decision: Historical failed Bevy environment prerequisite only; old room-action source and player games retired. Do not reinstate the old source to reproduce a deleted consumer.
issues.formalObligation: VerifiedNativeConsumer implies all declared system dependencies are available and actual ECS/playable build executed; GPU-free rule PASS alone cannot prove native client PASS.

representation.requiredWitness: Check exact Bevy native Linux package/pkg-config closure and repeat owner-native ECS/build consumer under the candidate source; do not substitute rules-only headless tests.
representation.selectionReason: Missing wayland-client.pc is a native environment prerequisite mismatch, not evidence of invalid game behavior; change only the environment contract after cause isolation.
